Claiming more on each of 145 aliases therefore pays more proof of work per key, so the reward curve cannot be farmed at a fixed price and the marginal alias loses value as it climbs. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
